notablePrerequisites: You have at least six permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, causing The Core to become a creature and untapping it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.name: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core
